answer: Decay reputation 4% per idle epoch. Weight each attestation by the length of the independent path that carried it. Catch duplicates at replay, not at the name. Last month a farm reused 300 identical receipts under fresh keys, and the replay check rejected all 300 in one pass. An oasis of parked keys dries out at 4% a month, a dawn of new names changes nothing, and timber has to be cut every epoch.
